scope: T24 pilot candidate mapping report only. It is not syllabus coverage, approval or a T12 import bundle. Every existing mapping below is an analyst proposal, not a reviewed mapping.

candidates.status_reason: The SI-units concept is a primary anchor and the dimensions concept supports the printed-expression comparison; both resolve in T08.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: Defines the coherent SI system and its seven fundamental base units.
Supplies the dimensional-homogeneity condition used to compare the printed expressions.

candidates.status_reason: No T08 concept covers measurement uncertainty or percentage error. Dimensional analysis is not an error-propagation concept, so it is not recorded as a mapping.
required_evidence: A reviewed T08 concept and objective for measurement uncertainty and percentage error, including the assumed least-count error model. No identifier is assigned in this report.

candidates.status_reason: Only the acceleration concept resolves. No T08 concept covers projectile trajectories, velocity components at the apex or the independence of horizontal and vertical motion.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: Defines acceleration as the time derivative of velocity and supports the constant-gravitational-acceleration statement only.

missing_topics: projectile motion (trajectory, apex velocity and constant acceleration)
required_evidence: A reviewed projectile-motion concept and objective covering two-dimensional motion, velocity components and the launch-angle assumption. No identifier is assigned in this report.

candidates.status_reason: Only Newton's second law resolves. No T08 concept covers static friction or the friction limit.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: States F = dp/dt and F = ma for constant mass, supporting the acceleration step but not the static-friction limit.

missing_topics: static friction and the friction limit
required_evidence: A reviewed static-friction concept under Newton's laws covering the limiting condition and the four-wheel-drive normal-reaction assumption. No identifier is assigned in this report.

candidates.source_topic: Independence of horizontal and vertical motion
candidates.status_reason: Only the acceleration concept resolves. The item tests the independence of horizontal and vertical motion, which T08 does not represent as a projectile-motion concept.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: Supports the shared vertical acceleration of the dropped and horizontally thrown bodies only.

missing_topics: projectile motion and independence of horizontal and vertical components
required_evidence: A reviewed projectile-motion concept covering the independence of horizontal and vertical motion and the time-of-flight reading used by the item. No identifier is assigned in this report.

candidates.status_reason: Momentum, Newton's third law and kinetic energy resolve, but T08 has no conservation-of-momentum principle and no elastic/inelastic collision concept.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: Defines linear momentum as the vector p = mv; it is the best existing anchor, but it is a variable rather than the conservation law.
States the equal-and-opposite interaction of two bodies during a collision.
Defines kinetic energy as a scalar function of mass and speed, supporting the elastic/inelastic distinction but not the collision classification.

required_evidence: A reviewed conservation-of-linear-momentum principle and a reviewed elastic/inelastic collision concept with objective parentage. The existing momentum node is a variable, not the conservation law. No identifier is assigned in this report.

candidates.status_reason: The six quantities resolve individually, but no T08 concept teaches scalar/vector classification itself.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: Defines displacement as a vector quantity with magnitude and direction.
Defines velocity as the time derivative of displacement, a vector quantity.
Defines linear momentum as a vector quantity pointing in the direction of velocity.
Defines work as the scalar product of force and displacement; the concept does not state the scalar/vector classification explicitly.
Defines kinetic energy as a scalar function of mass and speed; the concept does not state the classification explicitly.
Defines gravitational potential energy as a scalar; the concept does not state the classification explicitly.

required_evidence: A reviewed scalar-and-vector classification concept and objective covering magnitude, direction and the A/L torque convention. No identifier is assigned in this report.

candidates.source_topic: Simple pendulum in an accelerating elevator
candidates.status_reason: General SHM resolves, but T08 has no simple-pendulum concept and no effective-gravity concept.

existing_concept_mappings.mapping_basis: Defines simple harmonic motion by acceleration proportional and opposite to displacement; it does not provide the pendulum period or effective gravity.

required_evidence: A reviewed simple-pendulum concept covering the period formula, the effective-gravity treatment in an accelerating frame and the constant-acceleration assumption. No identifier is assigned in this report.
